summary: Frontend-only testing of Delivery Note (İrsaliye/Lieferschein) feature + HRB-Nummer setting on Gastromek CRM. All 7 targeted flows passed end-to-end via Playwright against the public preview URL: (1) Settings HRB field saves & persists across reload; (2) Quote toolbar shows delivery-note-btn and sidebar shows delivery-status-card with Offen/Bekliyor badges; (3) DE Lieferschein flow: select item 0, dn-create-btn downloads 'Lieferschein-AR-202604-0003-L1.pdf', dialog closes, no console errors; (4) delivery-status-item-0 flips to 'Geliefert' badge, item 1 stays 'Offen'; (5) WARNING flow: reopening dialog shows dn-delivered-badge-0, selecting both items triggers dn-warning + button label changes to 'Fortfahren', clicking again downloads 'Lieferschein-...-L2.pdf' and marks item 1 delivered; (6) BILINGUAL: switching dn-lang to Türkçe downloads 'Irsaliye-AR-202604-0003-L3.pdf'; (7) HRB rendered inside #quote-pdf-root (visible as 'HRB-Nr.: HRB 23433' in company info block); normal quote PDF DE and priceless PDF DE both downloaded successfully. Delivery numbers correctly auto-increment L1/L2/L3.
critical_code_review_comments: QuoteView.jsx grew to 610 lines — consider extracting DeliveryNoteDialog and the PDF generation logic (generatePdf, translations) into hooks/modules for maintainability.
openDn() sets dnLang based on UI lang only if 'tr'; it always resets to 'de' otherwise. Acceptable given only de/tr, but worth documenting.
In doCreateDeliveryNote, `setDnData(...)` state is used only during PDF render; the 500ms setTimeout race is fragile — consider useLayoutEffect gate or explicit ready flag.

DeliveryNoteTemplate uses `formatDate(new Date().toISOString())` at render time; if the same template re-renders across two RAFs during html2canvas the date is stable, but generally the delivery date should come from backend response for consistency.
seed_data_creation: None. However, the test quote AR-202604-0003 (3b645b60-0d9e-4cbf-9c61-5ed2270028c2) had delivered_items and delivery_note_seq mutated during this run: both item indices (0 and 1) are now flagged delivered and delivery_note_seq is at 3 (L1/L2/L3 issued). Main agent should reset this quote's delivered_items=[] and delivery_note_seq=0 (or use a throwaway quote next time) before re-testing the initial 'Offen/Bekliyor' state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend flows for delivery-note feature verified. Test quote AR-202604-0003 is now fully delivered (both items) with seq at L3. If retest of initial state is needed, use a different quote (e.g. ea3c3e37-ab99-49c5-86a6-089b75204e92 / AR-202604-0001) or reset delivered_items/delivery_note_seq via Mongo. HRB value 'HRB 23433' is persisted in CompanySettings.
